SELECT 
    s.School AS `School Name`,
    ROUND(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 4) AS `Free Meal Rate`,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN s.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS `Charter School`,
    s.GSserved AS `Grades it serves`,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(sats.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0 THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sats.NumGE1500 * 2 >= sats.NumTstTakr THEN 'Above Average'
        WHEN sats.NumGE1500 * 2 < sats.NumTstTakr AND sats.NumGE1500 * 1.5 >= sats.NumTstTakr THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Below Average'
    END AS `SAT Performance Level`
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores sats ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Alameda' AND f.`Low Grade` <= '12' AND f.`High Grade` >= '12'
GROUP BY 
    s.CDSCode
HAVING 
    `Free Meal Rate` = (
        SELECT MAX(`Free Meal Rate`) 
        FROM (
            SELECT ROUND(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`, 4) AS `Free Meal Rate`
            FROM frpm
            JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
            WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND `Low Grade` <= '12' AND `High Grade` >= '12'
        ) AS rates
    )
ORDER BY 
    `Free Meal Rate` DESC
